constraints: Keep the policy identity declared in .outcomegraph/policy.yaml unchanged: schema_version 2, name observe-policy, and mode observe.
Preserve the allowed file-write paths exactly as declared: .outcomegraph/**, export/**, skills/outcome-steward/**, and AGENTS.md.
Preserve the allow.verify_commands catalog exactly as declared in the policy file: npm test --listTests, npm test, go test ./..., and pytest -q.
Preserve the allowed sandbox operations exactly as declared: create_isolated_worktree, read_repo_state, and read_artifacts.
Preserve the deny lists exactly as declared for file writes, network, dependency-changing commands, and deployment actions.
goal: Capture the reusable observe-mode governance policy declared in .outcomegraph/policy.yaml, including policy identity, allowed writes, verification-command allowances, sandbox operations, and explicit denials.
